title: KANIT: an evidence-graded knowledge base of antimicrobial resistance biomarkers in the ESKAPEE pathogens
description:
The workflow that builds KANIT, a knowledge base of genomic biomarkers associated with antimicrobial resistance in the ESKAPEE pathogens. Gradient-boosted models predict laboratory resistance phenotypes from unitigs under lineage-aware cross-validation. Each candidate biomarker is graded by a fixed rule that combines concordance with a curated determinant in CARD with four statistical lines of evidence: differential prevalence, permutation importance, stability selection and a linear mixed model. A grade states an association with the phenotype, not that the biomarker causes resistance.

This record archives the source code (Nextflow workflow, Python steps, container definitions and tests). The knowledge base itself is deposited as a separate data record.
notes: Tool and database versions of the analysis are recorded in each run manifest and in the knowledge base.
